meta.title: Delivery app
meta.subtitle: Your own delivery channel in 4 connected apps: the order you place as a customer reaches the store, operations and the courier, and the delivery with a code closes it in all of them.
meta.sampleDataHint: Brand, stores, customers, couriers, orders and figures are fictitious. Payments, WhatsApp messages, calls, GPS and the map are simulated.
meta.footer: Demo with sample data from a fictitious brand (Fogón Demo) with 3 stores in Bogotá. Payments with Nequi, Daviplata, PSE or card, the WhatsApp message, the masked call, the courier position and the map are simulated: in your project they connect to the payment gateway, WhatsApp Business, a telephony provider, the courier's phone GPS and a map service (e.g. Google Maps or Mapbox). What you do is saved only in this browser.
meta.seoTitle: Delivery app: customer, store, operations and courier
meta.seoDescription: Interactive demo of an own delivery channel with sample data: order with simulated payment, store acceptance, assignment of the nearest courier, delivery with a code and calculated timing reports. Simulated map and tracking.
